8936640.variantName: Habitat 6ft Mixed Tip Upswept Christmas Tree
8936640.sourceDescription: Recreate the magic of a real tree without any of the fuss. This 6ft upswept Christmas tree brings classic festive charm with its natural foliage and light brown branches, all carefully detailed to look as lifelike as possible. You're getting a full-shaped artificial tree with 1951 tips in a mix of 3D and flat needles, giving it that thick, bushy appearance once you've fluffed and arranged the hinged branches to your liking. Assembly is straightforward. Just slot the pieces together into the metal stand and lower the branches, then spend a little time shaping them until they look just right. The tree comes ready to display as is, or you can load it up with baubles and lights if you prefer a more decorated look. Made from PVC with a sturdy metal base, it's designed for indoor use and packs away neatly in its box ready for next Christmas and many more after that. . knnmf5r2.baseName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Gold - 60 cm
knnmf5r2.variantName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Gold - 60 cm
knnmf5r2.sourceDescription: This Modern Metal Christmas tree exemplifies contemporary elegance, combining the simplicity of minimalist design with the charm of holiday cheer. Styled in a gleaming gold hue and a matte finish, it presents a tasteful blend of style and simplicity suited for any modern home setting. Its sleek form and contour make it an ideal centerpiece for living rooms or hallways, blending seamlessly into any seasonal decor scheme. Tailored for the modern holiday enthusiast, it projects a festive yet understated aura that is both captivating and inviting. Materials: Made from powder-coated steel, this Metal Christmas tree stands out with its robust, abrasion-resistant qualities. The selection of material not only contributes to a sleek modern look but ensures durability and lasting use through several festive seasons. Included Components: The tree features an integrated sturdy steel stand, providing reliable stability to keep it firmly upright. This component minimizes the need for additional supports, making setup straightforward and quick. Features /Function /Design: The tree embodies modern design, offering clean lines and minimal ornamentation. Its gold matte finish enhances its visual appeal, giving a chic touch to traditional Christmas decor while maintaining a functional and practical setup. Recommended Uses: This tree is perfect for both living room and hallway spaces. Its refined elegance easily transforms any indoor or sheltered outdoor area into a festive environment, allowing you to celebrate in style, whether you're entertaining guests or enjoying a quiet holiday. Care &Maintenance: Assemble the tree according to the manufacturer's instructions. Once the festive season is over, disassemble and store it carefully to preserve its condition for future use. Product Specifications Colour: Gold Material: Powder-coated steel Tree height: 60 cm Stand size: 23 x 10 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Metal Christmas tree • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
